findings.summary: The fractal-toy overview described a 'minimal 2D fractal demo (Mandelbrot, Julia)'. fractal-toy is a 3D raymarcher (Mandelbulb + Mandelbox, 4-DOF orbit camera, directional light + AO). Both toy overviews also credited the engine's RenderLoopDriver with driving their frames.
findings.change: Opening line rewritten to describe the real app, plus how formulas reach DDFS via registerFormula rather than featureRegistry. Both files' architecture lines corrected to name the actual frame owner. Both archive links given the missing history/ path segment.
findings.verification: Case-insensitive grep for mandelbrot|julia|2d over fractal-toy/ returns three hits, all prose in renderer/formulas/mandelbulb.ts explaining the Mandelbulb is the 3D extension OF the Mandelbrot set. `grep -rn RenderLoop fractal-toy/` returns nothing — FractalEngine owns its own requestAnimationFrame and calls viewport.frameTick() via onFrameEnd. `grep -rn TickRegistry fluid-toy/` also returns nothing, so 'fluidSim.ts advances the sim via TickRegistry' was wrong on both halves; useFluidEngine.ts owns the RAF. Link probe: 1 bad each before, 0 after.
